query_ground_truth.workflow_task: Prepare HubSpot launch assets for a paid event registration flow: assess payment-link feasibility, create a review-only automated confirmation email, create a disabled confirmation workflow, verify the assets remain inert, and attempt to create a custom-object registration ledger.
query_ground_truth.intent: Attempt to create a custom-object registration ledger to track event attendees.

requirement_groups.purpose: create a custom-object registration ledger schema

toolkit_connection_statuses.description: Zendesk provides customer support software with ticketing, live chat, and knowledge base features, enabling efficient helpdesk operations and customer engagement
toolkit_connection_statuses.status_message: No Active connection for toolkit=zendesk. You MUST call COMPOSIO_MANAGE_CONNECTIONS (toolkit="zendesk") to create a connection BEFORE executing any zendesk tools.

ZENDESK_CREATE_CUSTOM_OBJECT_RECORD.description: Create a new record for a custom object in Zendesk. Use when you need to add a new entry to a custom object type. The record is identified by its unique ID returned in the response. This action creates a new custom object record and returns the complete record data including the generated ID and timestamps.

name.description: User-defined display name for the object. If autonumbering is selected for the custom object's name field, the name isn't allowed because it's automatically generated. If uniqueness is enabled, the name must be unique.

external_id.description: An id you can use to link custom object records to external data

custom_object_key.description: The key of a custom object (e.g., 'car')

custom_object_fields.description: A dictionary of custom field key-value pairs. The available fields are defined in the custom object's field definitions.

ZENDESK_SHOW_CUSTOM_OBJECT.description: Get details of a specific Zendesk custom object by its key. Use when you have a custom object key and need to retrieve its metadata including name, description, attachment settings, visibility settings, and creation/update timestamps. This is a read-only, idempotent operation that returns the full custom object definition.

include_ui_path.description: Include UI path in the response. Set to true to retrieve the direct link to the custom object in the Zendesk UI.

custom_object_key.description: The key of a custom object. This is a user-defined unique identifier for the custom object type.

include_permissions_metadata.description: Include permission metadata in the response. Set to true to retrieve additional permission information for the custom object.

ZENDESK_LIST_ZENDESK_CUSTOM_OBJECT_FIELD.description: List all fields for a custom object in Zendesk. Use this action when you need to discover the structure of a custom object, understand what fields are available, or retrieve metadata about custom object fields for further operations like creating or updating records.

page.description: Pagination parameter. Supports both traditional offset and cursor-based pagination: traditional uses `?page=2` (integer page number); cursor uses `?page[size]=50&page[after]=cursor` (deepObject with size, after, before). Mutually exclusive.

per_page.description: Number of records to return per page. Maximum is 100 records per page for the custom-object-fields endpoint.

custom_object_key.description: The key of a custom object (e.g., 'car')

include_standard_fields.description: Include standard fields if true. Exclude them if false
